info.title: Lottify v1 API
info.description: Authoritative REST/OpenAPI contract for Lottify v1

createdByAdminId.description: Admin actor that created the Custom proposal

activationApprovalId.description: Immutable Approval evidence reference for Custom activation

cancellationRequestedByAdminId.description: Admin actor that initiated governed SCHEDULED cancellation

cancellationReason.description: Immutable reason for a pending or completed governed cancellation

closeRequestedByAdminId.description: Admin actor that initiated governed CLOSING period close

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page

reason.example: Align the future close window with an operational cycle

id.description: Persisted Automatic period id when already generated

reason.example: Operational exception no longer requires the Custom window

ledgerPostedAt.description: Half-open inspected Ledger posting window, expressed as an upper bound

reservationLifecycle.description: Half-open inspected Reservation lifecycle window, expressed as an upper bound

expected.description: Integer minor units per bucket metric, expected by the authoritative Ledger

observed.description: Integer minor units per bucket metric observed from the Wallet projection

difference.description: observed - expected, integer minor units per bucket metric

bucket.description: Wallet bucket the difference was observed in

amountMinor.description: Integer minor units on this side of the comparison

amountDifferenceMinor.description: observed - expected in integer minor units

outcome.description: Governed resolution outcome when the discrepancy is RESOLVED

actorRole.description: Actor role at the time of the action

resourceType.description: Target resource type of the audited action

payloadHash.description: Immutable SHA-256 hash of the action payload

correlationId.description: Stable correlation identity across the workflow

resourceType.description: Target resource type of the approved action

requestedVersion.description: Resource version the approval was granted against

payloadHash.description: Immutable SHA-256 hash of the approved payload

state.description: Every AdminApprovalEvidence record is created atomically with a required approvedAt, so its immutable state is APPROVED

source.description: Whether the window came from explicit instants or an authoritative Accounting Period

uncoveredRanges.description: Observable spans of the window no authoritative Accounting Period covers

unobservedRange.description: Span of the window later than `dataAsOf`, therefore not yet observable

debitAmountMinor.description: Total DEBIT postings in integer minor units

creditAmountMinor.description: Total CREDIT postings in integer minor units

projectionLagMs.description: Always 0: this report reads authoritative facts directly, with no projection

completeness.description: CURRENT when the whole window is observable and covered by authoritative Accounting Periods; LAGGING when the window extends past `dataAsOf`; PARTIAL when the observable window is not fully covered; REBUILDING is reserved for projection-backed Reporting outputs and is never returned by this authoritative read. Partial/lagging output is never definitive.

allowedActions.description: Lifecycle commands currently allowed by the Draw state machine.

eligible.description: True only when server time is strictly before the Draw cutoff.

resolvedPayout.description: Server-resolved payout for the line (opaque configuration value)
Server-resolved payout accepted for the line (opaque configuration value)
Payout accepted at confirmation (opaque configuration value)

authoritative.description: True only when the batch has COMPLETED

postedMinor.description: Posted balance in integer minor units

reservedMinor.description: Active reservations in integer minor units

availableMinor.description: Spendable balance in integer minor units

netImpactMinor.description: Signed net impact to the Member in minor units

amountMinor.description: Positive amount in integer minor units

ledgerTransactionId.description: Ledger transaction id when the deposit was credited

amountMinor.description: Positive amount in integer minor units

allowedActions.description: Only commands the caller is currently permitted to issue

accountNumber.description: Raw account reference; never persisted as-is

requiresApproval.description: True when the Approval queue owns the item

allowedActions.description: Currently allowed commands; never inferred from status alone

reason.example: Destination and payout evidence verified by review

turnoverTargetMinor.description: Turnover target in integer minor units

version.description: 0 when the preference was never stored

body.description: The exact text the Member must read before accepting

contentDigest.description: SHA-256 over the accepted Terms content

policyVersion.description: Policy version governing this Terms version

accepted.description: True only when a durable acceptance for this exact version exists

required.description: Terms versions currently required for this Member (may be empty)

satisfied.description: Every currently required Terms version has a durable acceptance

documentId.description: The Terms version the Member is accepting (from GET /member/terms)

contentDigest.description: SHA-256 over the accepted Terms content

alreadyAccepted.description: False on the first acceptance; true when this Member had already accepted it

phone.description: Login identity owned by Identity & Access

missingMandatoryFields.description: Mandatory fields with no stored value

profileComplete.description: True only when every mandatory field has a stored value
